svg.aria-label: A deposit machine on a base plate. Tokens slide out of a LaserStream hopper along a rail. Under a gate, a punch checks each one against a rack of stubs. New tokens carry on into the ledger bin and a dial counts them. Repeats are swung by a flap into a skipped tray. Tokens that are not deposits drop into an ignored tray before the gate.
